title: Coefficient extension commutes with ordinary module localization
statement: Let R, S and A be commutative rings with R-algebra structures on S and A. Let M be an A-module with compatible R-action. Give N=S⊗_R M the canonical action of C=S⊗_R A, specified by (s⊗a)(t⊗x)=st⊗ax. For every f in A there is an S-linear equivalence S⊗_R M_f → N_(1⊗f) sending s⊗(x/f^m) to (s⊗x)/(1⊗f)^m for all s, x and nonnegative m. No grading, flatness or regularity hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 00DK (localization is tensoring with the localized ring), 00D2 (tensor associativity for bimodules), and 07JZ (module fractions).

proof.text: Apply IsLocalizedModule.rTensor to the localization map M → M_f and the R-module S. This identifies M_f⊗_R S as a localization of M⊗_R S at the powers of f. Commute the factors to identify M⊗_R S with N as an A-module.

Restrict the ordinary localization map N → N_(1⊗f) along A → C. IsLocalizedModule.restrictScalars_powers makes it another localization at the powers of f. The universal property gives an A-linear equivalence E from M_f⊗_R S to N_(1⊗f), with E((x/1)⊗s)=(s⊗x)/1.

Multiplication by f^m is injective on the localized target. Multiply the desired fraction formula by f^m; both sides reduce to the denominator-one formula, so E((x/f^m)⊗s)=(s⊗x)/(1⊗f)^m. Commute the source tensor factors. This formula proves S-linearity on pure tensors of fractions, and two inductions extend it to every tensor.

theorem exists_localization_scalarExtension_coefficients_equiv
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {A : Type w} {M : Type t}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R A] [Module R M] [Module A M] [IsScalarTower R A M]
    (f : A) :
    let ρ : (S ⊗[R] A) →ₐ[S] Module.End S (S ⊗[R] M) :=
      AlgHom.liftEquiv R S A _
        ((Module.End.baseChangeHom R S M).comp (Algebra.lsmul R R M))
    letI : Module (S ⊗[R] A) (S ⊗[R] M) := Module.compHom _ ρ.toRingHom
    letI : IsScalarTower S (S ⊗[R] A) (S ⊗[R] M) :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul
        (fun s x ↦ congrArg (fun g : Module.End S (S ⊗[R] M) ↦ g x) (ρ.commutes s))
    ∃ e : (S ⊗[R] LocalizedModule.Away f M) ≃ₗ[S]
      LocalizedModule.Away (1 ⊗ₜ[R] f : S ⊗[R] A) (S ⊗[R] M),
      ∀ (s : S) (m : ℕ) (x : M),
        e (s ⊗ₜ[R] mk x (⟨f ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f)) =
          mk (s ⊗ₜ[R] x)
            (⟨(1 ⊗ₜ[R] f : S ⊗[R] A) ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ :
              Submonoid.powers (1 ⊗ₜ[R] f : S ⊗[R] A))
